sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Octriallach was an Irish hero. The Fomorians, an early race of Irish lore, usually appear as a fearsome horde beneath king Balor, the man of the Evil Eye. Octriallach was an exception, a spy who discovered the Tuatha De Danann secrets. Their physician Dian Cecht bathed the wounded in the magic Well of Slaine. The well healed all wounds but could not reconnect a severed head or limb. Once Octriallach discovered this, he filled the well with earth. Ogma, the god of eloquence, then killed him.

okr.objective: Octriallach was a Fomorian spy who disabled the Well of Slaine.
